about.title: Who We Are
about.description: We are Mauricio Garzón and Laura Mestra, a two-person senior team with over six years of experience building high-impact software for businesses around the world.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Have a project in mind? Get in touch and tell us what you need. We reply within 24 hours. JOSUE 24:15 SAS — Software House.

hero.title: Software development focused on real results
hero.lead: We build websites, automations and digital solutions that help businesses capture opportunities and operate more efficiently.

whatWeDo.title: Digital solutions shaped around your business
whatWeDo.lead: Every project is different. These are the main ways we can help you.

items.title: Websites for businesses
items.content: Sites designed to communicate clearly, build trust and make it easy for potential customers to reach you.

items.title: Websites for events
items.content: Digital spaces to share details, register attendees and centralize all communication around the event.

items.title: Real estate projects
items.content: Pages built to capture genuine interest and organize information from prospective buyers.

items.title: Process automation
items.content: Workflows that connect forms, messages and tools to cut manual work and improve follow-up.

items.title: Custom development
items.content: Tailored solutions for specific needs that don't fit a standard format.

items.title: Optimization and support
items.content: Tweaks, improvements and maintenance so everything keeps working properly over time.

theProblem.title: When technology isn't well structured...
theProblem.lead: Many businesses have the tools, the processes and a digital presence, but something breaks down in how it all connects.
items: Information that doesn't flow between systems
Manual processes that eat up time
Experiences that don't guide the user properly
theProblem.conclusion: The problem isn't a lack of tools, it's how they're organized.

whoWeAre.title: A small, focused, complementary team
whoWeAre.lead: We combine technical vision with a business perspective to build solutions that don't just work, but make sense in the context of each project.

engineering.description: Responsible for designing and building the technical foundation of every project. From websites to process automation, the focus is on creating stable, fast, well-structured solutions.
engineering.name: Mauricio Garzón Brunal
engineering.title: Full-Stack & RN Developer
engineering.bio: Builds full-stack web and mobile applications — backends with Express and NestJS, SQL and NoSQL databases, frontends with React, React Native and Vue.js. Working on product teams since 2019.

business.description: Responsible for understanding the business, structuring the user experience and making sure every solution has a clear objective. From definition through validation, everything is built with practical sense.
business.name: Laura Mestra Ruíz
business.title: Project Manager · Scrum Master
business.bio: International Business professional and certified Scrum Master. Manages software projects with clear objectives, team leadership and agile methodologies since 2021.
